svg.aria-label: Entity-relationship diagram of auth_db and vaullet_db. In auth_db, outbox references accounts, at most one account-created event per account. A relay posts each event to the ledger, which opens the wallets and the account_balances row for the same account_id. In vaullet_db, wallets, balance_buckets, reservations and ledger_entries reference account_balances; balance_buckets references wallets; reservation_allocations and ledger_entries reference balance_buckets and reservations.
